reviews.name: Danielle B.
reviews.text: I had my sink in the kitchen replaced from a double bowl to a single. The new sink is a little bit bigger so we needed the hole in the counter to be a little bit bigger. We also wanted a disposal switch added. They were able to schedule VERY quickly! The work was done VERY carefully and done perfectly!! I could not be any more pleased with how everything turned out. It looks like we bought the house with this sink already installed.

reviews.name: Joshua O.
reviews.text: They did an amazing job, especially with my special situation. I had a very complex and difficult job for them, it was not your standard job. I had a large shower with many shelves, and areas around two windows and a bathtub, along with a pony wall. I lined them all with solid granite surfaces. Some of the surfaces had tile that made them not straight. They were able to deal with that as well, by wrapping the tile edge in the granite. They did it all perfectly! I would use them again for sure.

reviews.name: Deb C.
reviews.text: Audrey was amazing. Her and Ned were very customer oriented in helping me replace all the countertops in my home; kitchen and bathrooms.

reviews.name: Alyson H.
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience working with Audrey at Graebridge Stone for our laundry room countertop. From the moment we walked into the showroom, she was fantastic: helpful, knowledgeable, and quick to get us an estimate. Even though this was a small job, she never treated us any differently, which was so refreshing. We were looking for a remnant piece, and she even let us visit their facility to explore options. We found a gorgeous piece of marble that looks incredible in the space. Audrey also went above and beyond by helping us communicate with the cabinet contractor to ensure the proper support was in place for the countertop. After the template was done, the installation was completed in under two weeks. The entire process was smooth and professional, and we will definitely be calling Audrey when we finish our basement.

reviews.name: Autumn L.
reviews.text: I have worked on several projects with Graebridge and consider them a first class provider of countertops and solid surfaces. Audrey is a pleasure to work with on design, pricing and scheduling. The last project we worked together on was extremely difficult by way of schedule and design. We did tops and additional items in showers and surrounds. The Graebridge team did wonderful and overcame every hurdle that came our way and helped us meet a tight schedule along with pleasing a tough customer. We consider Graebridge one of our most dependable and valuable trades. Marc - Magleby Construction

reviews.name: Haylee J.
reviews.text: Graebridge was so easy to work with! Their showroom had so many options to choose from, highly educated staff, and a competely relaxed environment. It was so hard to choose from all of the amazing styles and selection as they had so many gorgeous styles to choose from! Once we made our decision, the measuring and installation process went flawlessly. The installers were very professional, they cleaned all of the dust and debris, and hauled off our old countertop for us! HIGHLY recommend Graebridge! Wish I could give them 10 stars! I HATED my old countertops, and it wasn’t until they were severally damaged did I finally decide it was time for a change. And Graebridge did a beautiful job, that I finally LOVE my kitchen for the first time since we bought our home in 2020! I can’t thank them enough!
